Looking for a StopLight…
 

Network settings

Your device needs to be on the same WiFi as the StopLight. The app automatically tries any StopLight units it's found before, a short list of expected names (), and a scan of .*. If none answer, type the controller's IP/hostname above, or scan a different subnet (tries .1–.254 and keeps anything that calls itself a "stoplight"). Found devices are remembered on this device only.
